info.name: Tapi Super-Search API
info.description:
# Tapi — Super-Search API

Backend endpoints for the **Super-Search** feature (global search across Chats, Tasks, and Bills). PRD: *Super-Search Feature · Sprint 2 · v1.6.21*.

## Data source: LIVE (MongoDB)
Every endpoint queries the real collections (`rooms`, `tasks`, `bills`, `messages`) scoped to the authenticated user — **no static fixtures**. Results reflect the caller's own chats/tasks/bills. IDs in responses are real Mongo ObjectIds.

## Getting started
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (default `http://localhost:40000`).
2. Run **Get Dev Test Token** once (dev only) — its test script auto-fills `authToken` for every request.
3. Collection-level **Bearer auth** (`{{authToken}}`) applies to every request except the token endpoint (No Auth). Auth is the shared `verifyToken` middleware.
4. Set `taskId` / `billId` to real ids returned by the search endpoints to try the detail requests.

## Mount point
All routes are under **`/api/search`** (mounted in `messaging/src/init.js`).

## Conventions
- Query is a case-insensitive substring match: chat title / DM counterpart name (chats), task title (tasks), bill code or title (bills). **Minimum 1 char** or results are empty.
- `filters` is a comma-separated list of pill keys (see each request). Pills are OR-combined within a tab.
- Chats come back **flat** (`results[]`); Tasks & Bills come back **grouped by chat** (`groups[]`).
- Bill `direction` is viewer-relative: `owedToMe` (you are the sender) or `iOwe` (you are the recipient). Status pill + `payable` derive from the numeric bill `state` + direction.

query.description: Phone to mint/find a test user for. Blocked in production (403).

request.description: Mints a JWT for a test user (creating the user if needed). **Non-production only** — returns 403 when `NODE_ENV=production`. The test script below stores `token` into the `authToken` collection variable so every other request is authenticated.

query.description: Search query (min 1 char). Matches group title or DM counterpart name.
Pills: groups · direct · private · hasTasks · hasBills · unread

request.description: Chats tab. Flat `results[]` of chat cards. `unread`, `taskCount`, `billCount` and `matchCount` are computed live from the `messages`/`tasks`/`bills` collections.

response.name: 200 — chat results
response.body:

  "type": "chats",

query.description: Pills: assignedToMe · assignedToOthers · inProgress · highPriority · dueThisWeek · completed

request.description: Tasks tab. `groups[]` — each group is a chat header + its matching task rows (from `tasks` in the caller's rooms). `status`/`due`/`priority` derive from the numeric task fields.

response.name: 200 — tasks grouped by chat

request.description: Bills tab. `groups[]` — chat header + matching bill rows. Backed by `billService.listBillsForUser` (matches bill **code or title**, chat-pair scoped to the caller).

response.name: 200 — bills grouped by chat

request.description:
Full Task detail. Membership-checked (caller must be in the task's room → else 403). Returns source chat, status/due/priority/assignee, description, subtasks + progress, attachments.

**Note:** `activity` is currently `[]` — the activity log (TaskActivity collection) is wired in Phase 2.

request.description: Full Bill detail. Membership-checked (caller must be in sender or recipient chat → else 403). Returns amount heading + status, invoice info, line items + total, and a `timeline` built from the bill's state `history` (each event carries a `state` and an i18n `key` under `bills.history.*` for the client to localise).

formdata.description: Optional partial amount. Omit to pay the full remaining balance.

request.description: Submit & Pay Bill. Pre-gateway this performs the real recipient action — `billService.markPaid` (bill → PaymentClaimed) — and returns the updated bill. **The actual payment-gateway charge is Phase 2** (`gateway: "stub-phase2"`). Sender-side callers (you can't pay a bill owed to you) or bills not in a payable state → **409**.

response.name: 409 — not payable
